defs.d: The substance constituting earth's atmosphere, particularly:
defs.ex: I'm going outside to get some air.

defs.d: (usually with the) The apparently open space above the ground which this substance fills, formerly thought to be limited by the firmament but now considered to be surrounded by the near vacuum of outer space.
defs.ex: The flock of birds took to the air.

defs.d: To bring (something) into contact with the air, so as to freshen or dry it.
To let fresh air into a room or a building, to ventilate.
A failure to hit.
A failure to obtain or accomplish.
To fail to hit.
defs.ex: I missed the target.

defs.d: To fail to achieve or attain.
defs.ex: to miss an opportunity

defs.d: To occur or take place.
defs.ex: Let me tell you how it happened.

defs.d: To happen to; to befall.
Maybe, perhaps.
A requirement for something; something needed.
defs.ex: I've always tried to have few needs beyond food, clothing and shelter.

defs.d: Lack of means of subsistence; poverty; indigence; destitution.
A civil force granted the legal authority for law enforcement and maintaining public order.
defs.ex: Call the police!

defs.d: A police officer.
To enforce the law and keep order among (a group).
defs.ex: Extra security was hired to police the crowd at the big game.

defs.d: To clean up an area.
A subjective belief, judgment or perspective that a person has formed about a topic, issue, person or thing.
defs.ex: Every man is a fool in some man's opinion.

defs.d: The judgment or sentiment which the mind forms of persons or things; estimation.
To have or express as an opinion.
A person who teaches, especially one employed in a school.
The index finger; the forefinger.
An evergreen tree of the genus Citrus such as Citrus sinensis.
The fruit of an orange tree; a citrus fruit with a slightly sour flavour.
To color orange.
To become orange.
Having the colour of the fruit of an orange tree; yellowred; reddish-yellow.
A reading or an act of reading, especially an actor's part of a play.
(in combination) Something to be read; a written work.
defs.ex: His thrillers are always a gripping read.

defs.d: To look at and interpret letters or other information that is written.
defs.ex: Have you read this book?

defs.d: To speak aloud words or other information that is written. Often construed with a to phrase or an indirect object.
defs.ex: All right, class, who wants to read next?

defs.d: An official document normally used for international journeys, which proves the identity and nationality of the person for whom it was issued.
defs.ex: You will have to bring your passport to prove who you are.

defs.d: (by extension) Any document that allows entry or passage.

A piece of information describing, or an account of certain events given or presented to someone, with the most common adpositions being by (referring to creator of the report) and on (referring to the subject).
defs.ex: A report by the telecommunications ministry on the phone network revealed a severe capacity problem.

defs.d: Reputation.
To relate details of (an event or incident); to recount, describe (something).
To repeat (something one has heard), to retell; to pass on, convey (a message, information etc.).
A picture created by projecting an image onto a photosensitive surface such as a chemically treated plate or film, CCD receptor, etc.
To take a photograph of.
To fix permanently in the memory etc.
A representation of anything (as a person, a landscape, a building) upon canvas, paper, or other surface, by drawing, painting, printing, photography, etc.
An image; a representation as in the imagination.
To represent in or with a picture.
To imagine or envision.
The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)
Something like such a unit of language:
To say or write (something) using particular words; to phrase (something).
defs.ex: I’m not sure how to word this letter to the council.

defs.d: To flatter with words, to cajole.
Truth, indeed, that is the truth! The shortened form of the statement "My word is my bond."
defs.ex: "Yo, that movie was epic!" / "Word?" ("You speak the truth?") / "Word." ("I speak the truth.")

defs.d: (stereotypically) An abbreviated form of word up; a statement of the acknowledgment of fact with a hint of nonchalant approval.
The colour of gold, butter, or a lemon; the colour obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light.
The intermediate light in a set of three traffic lights, the illumination of which indicates that drivers should stop short of the intersection if it is safe to do so.
To become yellow or more yellow.
To make (something) yellow or more yellow.
Having yellow as its colour.
Lacking courage.
The interior or inner part.
defs.ex: The inside of the building has been extensively restored.

defs.d: The left-hand side of a road if one drives on the left, or right-hand side if one drives on the right.
defs.ex: On a motorway, you should never pass another vehicle on the inside.

defs.d: Of or pertaining to the inner surface, limit or boundary.
defs.ex: The inside surface of the cup is unpainted.

defs.d: Nearer to the interior or centre of something.
defs.ex: All the window seats were occupied, so she took an inside seat.

defs.d: Within or towards the interior of something; within the scope or limits of something (a place), especially a building.
defs.ex: It started raining, so I went inside.

defs.d: Indoors.
defs.ex: It was snowing, so the children stayed inside.

defs.d: The act of jumping; a leap; a spring; a bound.
An effort; an attempt; a venture.
To propel oneself rapidly upward, downward and/or in any horizontal direction such that momentum causes the body to become airborne.
defs.ex: Kangaroos are known for their ability to jump high.

defs.d: To cause oneself to leave an elevated location and fall downward.
defs.ex: She is going to jump from the diving board.

defs.d: Exact; matched; fitting; precise.
(manner) In a different way.
To practice an ability.
defs.ex: She trained seven hours a day to prepare for the Olympics.

defs.d: To teach and form (someone) by practice; to educate (someone).
defs.ex: You can't train a pig to write poetry.

defs.d: Action of the verb to train.
The activity of imparting and acquiring skills.
An advance or movement made from one foot to the other; a pace.
A rest, or one of a set of rests, for the foot in ascending or descending, as a stair, or a rung of a ladder.
To move the foot in walking; to advance or recede by raising and moving one of the feet to another resting place, or by moving both feet in succession.
To walk; to go on foot; especially, to walk a little distance.
defs.ex: to step to one of the neighbors

defs.d: A slab of clay used for inscription.
A short scripture written by the founders of the Bahá'í faith.
To form (a drug, etc.) into tablets.
The organization of knowledge for practical purposes.
All the different and usable technologies developed by a culture or people.
Thought; gerund of think.
defs.ex: What is your thinking on this subject?

defs.d: Thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen; feeling afraid and unhappy.
defs.ex: She was worried about her son who had been sent off to fight in the war.

defs.d: To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.
defs.ex: Stop worrying about your test, it’ll be fine.

defs.d: Disturb the peace of mind of; afflict with mental agitation or distress.
defs.ex: Your tone of voice worries me.

defs.d: The forces or behaviours that are the enemy of evil. Usually consists of helping others and general benevolence.
A result that is positive in the view of the speaker.
That which is produced, then traded, bought or sold, then finally consumed.
(often preceded by the) Something authentic, important, or revealing.
A fashionable person; a fop
Characteristic of or influenced by a current popular trend or style.
defs.ex: a fashionable dress; a fashionable man

defs.d: Established or favoured by custom or use; current; prevailing at a particular time.
defs.ex: the fashionable philosophy; fashionable opinions

defs.d: To place; to set in a particular spot or position.
To find out where something is located.
Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.
defs.ex: Why do my relatives always talk about sex?

defs.d: A type of adjective that inflects like a relative clause, rather than a true adjective, in certain Bantu languages.
Connected to or depending on something else; comparative.
(of a URL, URI, path, or similar) Expressed in relation to another item, rather than in complete form.
defs.ex: The relative URL /images/pic.jpg, when evaluated in the context of http://example.com/docs/pic.html, corresponds to the absolute URL http://example.com/images/pic.jpg.

defs.d: (chiefly in the plural) That which is left; relic; remainder.
(in the plural) That which is left of a human being after the life is gone; relics; a dead body.

To stay behind while others withdraw; to be left after others have been removed or destroyed; to be left after a number or quantity has been subtracted or cut off; to be left as not included or comprised.
To continue unchanged in place, form, or condition, or undiminished in quantity; to abide; to stay; to endure; to last.
defs.ex: There was no food in the house, so I had to remain hungry.

defs.d: To direct words and/or thoughts to God or any higher being, for the sake of adoration, thanks, petition for help, etc.
defs.ex: Muslims pray in the direction of Mecca.

defs.d: To humbly beg a person for aid or their time.
Please; used to make a polite request.
defs.ex: pray silence for…

defs.d: (focus) Especially, extremely.
defs.ex: The apéritifs were particularly stimulating.

defs.d: (degree) To a great extent.
A thing that is extremely holy; used almost exclusively in Holy of Holies.
Dedicated to a religious purpose or a god.
defs.ex: I'm planning to visit the holy city of Jerusalem this Christmas.

defs.d: Revered in a religion.
To explain in detail.
defs.ex: I'll detail the exact procedure to you later.

defs.d: To clean carefully (particularly of road vehicles) (always pronounced. /ˈdiːteɪl/)
defs.ex: We need to have the minivan detailed.

defs.d: Characterized by attention to detail and thoroughness of treatment.
The lowest limit.
defs.ex: We need a minimum of three staff members on duty at all time.

defs.d: The smallest amount.
defs.ex: He always tries to get away with doing the minimum.

defs.d: To the lowest degree.
To encounter or discover by accident; to happen upon.
To encounter or discover something being searched for; to locate.
defs.ex: I found my car keys. They were under the couch.

defs.d: Food and lodging; board.
That which is produced or occurs as a result of an event or process.
defs.ex: A quality automobile is the outcome of the work of skilled engineers and thousands of workers.

defs.d: The result of a random trial. An element of a sample space.
defs.ex: Three is a possible outcome of tossing a six-sided die.

defs.d: (with on or upon, formerly also with in) to trust; to have confidence in; to depend.
To do enough for; to meet the needs of; to fulfill the wishes or requirements of.
defs.ex: I'm not satisfied with the quality of the food here.

defs.d: To cause (a sentence) to be true when the sentence is interpreted in one's universe.
